rtr.text: The Selesnyan settlement is Cecilee's community, where she adopts an abandoned infant with a Gruul tattoo and names him Ruzi, but a Gruul shaman comes to take him back and the Gruul begin attacking the Selesnyans.
Before sunrise an ogre breaks through the gate followed by Massacre Girl and her men, who rip up the young guild tree, cut off Cecilee's hair and cut her throat while her followers lie dead.
Her brother Ruzi arrives with the wolf Kuma, and after Massacre Girl refuses to say who hired her and leaves, they kill the ogre and Ruzi buries the dead in a mass grave, including his sister.
Ruzi finds baby Zi alive in a hidden cradle and resolves to break from Selesnya to make destroying Massacre Girl his purpose.
